reason: The report uses a bare regression with no controls, even though the data has pre-period confounders (2020 firm size, age, prior patenting, and others) that correlate with remote_share. When I added those 2020 controls, the coefficient fell from about 2.3 untrimmed (2.07 in the report) to about 0.75. The reported effect is therefore heavily inflated by confounding, and the causal 'positive effect' claim is not supported at the stated magnitude.
